title: Kong Salmon Pink Coleus - 2x Mini Plug Plant - Rare Unusual Pink Coleus
description:
Add bold colour and tropical texture to your garden or home with Coleus ‘Kong Salmon Pink’, a striking foliage plant known for its extra-large, vibrant leaves. This variety features bright green edges with a salmon-pink centre and contrasting reddish tones, making it a standout in shaded areas.


 Plant Details
 

 Botanical Name: Solenostemon scutellarioides
 

 Common Names: Coleus, Flame Nettle, Painted Nettle, Painted Leaf
 

 Plant Type: Tender perennial (usually grown as an annual in the UK)
 

 Height: Approx. 45–55 cm (18–20 inches)
 

 Growth Habit: Upright, bushy, well-branched
 

 Foliage: Large, colourful leaves with pink centre and green margins
 

 Bloom Season: Spring to Autumn (grown mainly for foliage)


 Growing Conditions
 

 Light: Shade to partial shade (ideal for shaded patios, borders, and containers)
 

 Soil: Rich, moist, well-drained soil (pH 5.6–7.5)
 

 Watering: Keep soil consistently moist but not waterlogged
 

 Temperature: Thrives in warm, humid conditions
 

 Hardiness: Not frost hardy – protect from cold


 Uses
 

 Perfect for shaded beds, borders, and containers
 

 Excellent for patio pots and hanging baskets
 

 Ideal as a colourful indoor houseplant
 

 Great for adding tropical-style foliage displays


 Care Tips
 

 Pinch out tips to encourage bushier growth
 

 Protect from frost – bring indoors or treat as annual
 

 Harden off before planting outside
 

 Performs best in warm, sheltered positions


 Please Note
 

 You will receive 1 x mini plug plant, ready to pot on
 

 Plants may vary slightly in size and appearance depending on season
 

 Images are for reference only


 A reliable, easy-to-grow foliage plant that delivers bold colour all season long, suitable for both beginners and experienced gardeners.
